overall_assessment: Regular emneplaner (all 8 random controls) are split well: learning outcomes complete across Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse, arbeidskrav correctly separated from assessment. The suspects are almost all Praksis/shell courses where the harvested plan is only a pointer or a long fagplan, yielding placeholder 'Se fagplanen.' rows or nothing; no reading_list is ever extracted.

findings.description: For Praksis courses (M1GP*/M5GP*, 15 of 20 suspects) the extractor emits six rows (prerequisites, learning_outcomes, course_content, teaching_methods, coursework_requirements, assessment), each containing only the placeholder 'Se fagplanen.'. These are empty placeholders emitted as real section rows and would be counted as populated sections downstream.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The institution-specific section strategy fills every section with the 'Se fagplanen.' stub text that appears in the source page, and .clean_sections() does not drop pointer-only text.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() (R/extract_sections.R) drop rows whose text matches ^(Se (under )?.{0,40}fagplan(en)?\.?\s*)+$ so they become missing rather than placeholder rows.

findings.description: In the Praksis courses the assessment section is the same stub repeated three times (43 chars), i.e. several source blocks (eksamen, vurdering, karakter) concatenated under assessment with identical text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Multiple headings (Vurdering, Eksamen, ...) map to assessment and their identical stub text is concatenated without de-duplication.
findings.suggested_fix: De-duplicate identical paragraphs when merging multiple blocks into one section in .clean_sections().

findings.description: The Praksis plans contain a long 'Fagplan' (Innledning, Organisering og arbeidsmåter, Veiledning, Vurdering, Samarbeid ...) with real teaching_methods, assessment and content text (~10k+ chars), yet none of it is extracted; only stubs are output. Real section content is dropped.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Section strategy only recognises the EPN-V2 headings and the stub rows, and has no heading mappings for the embedded Fagplan (Innledning, Organisering og arbeidsmåter, Undervisning, Veiledning, Vurdering).
findings.suggested_fix: Add heading patterns in R/section_heading_map.R for the Fagplan headings (Organisering og arbeidsmåter/Undervisning/Veiledning -> teaching_methods, Vurdering -> assessment, Innledning -> course_content) and make the oslomet strategy split the Fagplan block when the main sections are only 'Se fagplanen.'.

findings.description: 4 suspects have a plan consisting only of title, credits, Emnehistorikk and Programplan; no sections can be extracted. The extractor result (nothing) is right for the given text, but the plan text itself is an empty shell, so the course has no section data at all.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Upstream harvest/extraction: the page body (emneplan content, possibly in the Fagplan tab) was not captured for these course versions.
findings.suggested_fix: Check the fulltext step for these courses (selector missed content or page genuinely empty); flag courses with plans lacking any content heading as no_content in QA rather than relying on section extraction.

findings.description: No course in the packet, including all 8 random controls, has a reading_list row. The plan text has an empty 'Pensum' heading directly followed by 'Timeplan', so the pensum list (loaded separately on OsloMet pages) is not in the harvested text at all.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Pensum is rendered dynamically/in a separate element not captured by the oslomet selector in R/institution_config.R, so reading_list cannot be extracted.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the oslomet fetch/selector to include the pensum block (or fetch the pensum endpoint) and map 'Pensum' in R/section_heading_map.R to reading_list.

findings.description: Prerequisites hold either a pointer ('Se under Opptakskrav i fagplanen.') or admission/study-right text ('Faget er tilgjengelig som valgfag for aktive studenter ... Eksterne søkere må ha bestått lærerutdanning'), which the rubric excludes from prerequisites. Only a minority (e.g. 'Norsk 2 bygger på Norsk 1.') are genuine.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Opptakskrav' / 'Forkunnskaper' headings map to prerequisites without filtering pointer or admission text.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop prerequisites rows matching ^Se (under )?.*fagplan and strip admission-only paragraphs (Opptak, søkere, valgfag for aktive studenter) in .clean_sections().

findings.description: Assessment includes exam-logistics boilerplate (Ny/utsatt eksamen, hjelpemidler, egenerklæring/NSD attachments, grade scale) and a stray pointer line 'Se under Vurdering/eksamen.'; in the nynorsk course the text also has stray ';' separators ('deleksamenar.;Karakterar'), also seen in course_content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis:
HTML
/list separators rendered as ';' in extracted text and the whole Vurdering block kept without logistics stripping.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove standalone 'Se (under) Vurdering/eksamen.' lines and replace stray ';' separators with newlines in the oslomet pre/post-processing (extract text step).
